reviewer: artifact-critic subagent (model: opus), fresh context, harness-native: same provider family as the producer, so weaker independence than the gateway judge
reviewed: plan.md as of 2026-10-09 04:06 (65 tasks), against the emitted OpenSpec changes

findings.claim: The public-agent go-live gate depends on controlling when the seed runs, but CI runs the seed on every approved deploy; once change 8's policy and seed edits are merged, A2UI turns on for the public agent at the next approved deploy of anything, whatever the red-team result.
findings.evidence: .github/workflows/site.yml:136 'Seed the site agent (idempotent, every deploy)'; scripts/seed-site-agent.sh:56 'the agent PUT is a full replace'; plan.md 'The seed is the on-switch'.
findings.suggested_fix: Make change 8's PR mergeable only after the red team passes locally; make change 7's switch default OFF and turned on as a separate CP3 action; replace 'the seed is the on-switch' with the real mechanism.

findings.claim: It is unclear who publishes PEM; the plan hands the irreversible npm publish to an agent with no separate operator go after the dry run.
findings.evidence: goals.md: 'The operator publishes PEM; make the needed changes there and publish with an updated version number.'; plan CP2 action only 'Merge the PEM PR'; pem task 1.8 dry run and publish in one task.
findings.suggested_fix: Split 1.8 into a dry run with a packed-manifest report and a publish, with an explicit CP2 operator approval between them.

findings.claim: The release trains are not enforced: every merge to main without [skip ci] starts a production deploy and an approved deploy ships everything merged so far.
findings.evidence: site.yml on push to main; environment production approval only.
findings.suggested_fix: State the merge discipline: hold changes 4-8 or merge with [skip ci] and run CP3 as one workflow_dispatch; operator rejects intermediate deploy runs.

findings.claim: The plan builds against UAR origin/main but production and the local stack run an older pinned UAR, and no change bumps it; UAR #361 cancelled-with-usage is not deployed.
findings.evidence: k8s/base/uar-deployment.yaml and docker-compose.yaml pin digest 688a97e4 (built from the #344 merge); origin/main has #358, #360, #361 after it.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a task gated by an operator checkpoint to bump the UAR digest, or scope the cancelled-usage rendering and change 9's done-when to what the pinned UAR emits.

findings.claim: Change 8 adds a model-facing tool to the public agent, which breaks the existing FR-11 test and depends on D-15 (the public tool list, still undecided); no change-8 task updates either, yet the plan claims change 8 completes those tasks.
findings.evidence: site-agent-tool-allowlist tasks 1.5; plan 'A2UI parts of site-agent-tool-allowlist 1.2, 1.5 and 1.6 (change 8)'.
findings.suggested_fix: Add change-8 tasks to record the D-15 decision and to update and run the FR-11 test.

findings.claim: Change 5 moves the app's entity-graph library up two minors, past a behaviour change, without naming it or testing for regressions.
findings.evidence: package.json pins entity-graph-core and the alias at 4.0.2; RELEASING.md: 4.1.0 makes garbage collection treat list membership as a reference.
findings.suggested_fix: Make the entity-graph bump an explicit task with a regression check.

findings.claim: The carrier spike and adapter run after PEM is published; if the adapter has to live in PEM, a second 13-package release follows.
findings.evidence: app-a2ui-surface-renderer 1.2 spike, 1.3 adapter into the PEM processor; change 5 depends on the PEM publish.
findings.suggested_fix: Move the carrier spike before PEM release prep and state the adapter lives in this repo.

findings.claim: The plan says the per-change triggers run inside each final task, but the tasks do not contain them.
findings.evidence: plan.md per-change validation paragraph; tasks say only 'tests and build pass'.
findings.suggested_fix: Put npm test && npm run lint, cargo test and a per-round npm run build into the final tasks and round order.

findings.claim: The allowlist's test commitments never made it into the change's tasks; the agui.state.patch path filter has no implementation or test task and its mixed-path behaviour is undefined.
findings.evidence: plan 'every allowed and every denied name gets a test'; change 2 task 1.2 tests only the four diagnostic types.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend the tasks: one test per allowed and denied name, path-filter tests including a mixed-op patch, and a stated rule.

findings.claim: The red-team task is ambiguous about where it runs ('rendered live' suggests production), which makes the go-live gate circular or skips the real public path.
findings.suggested_fix: State 1.6 runs on the local compose stack through the site proxy on :8080 with the opt-in on, and a post-deploy re-run is part of the go-live task.

findings.claim: The live verification tasks record evidence but set no pass conditions, so change 10 can close while rendering or the leak fix is broken.
findings.suggested_fix: Add assertions: zero non-allowlisted types; at least one a2ui artifact present if A2UI is on; surface renders as components in the captures.

findings.claim: The plan lists what the spend meter reads as unknown but this repo's code answers it.
findings.evidence: server/src/domain/agui_filter.rs signal() maps agui.message.delta, agui.done, agui.cancelled, agui.error; meter.rs reads usage from agui.done.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the unknown with the citation and test all four.

findings.claim: 'The public template needs nothing beyond the nine' is a planner decision not recorded in the decision log.
findings.suggested_fix: Record it as a decision with the fallback.
